title: Darkest Fear/Totomi Regression
author: DaCringeyBaka
body:
### App DB report link

https://appdb.touchhle.org/apps/603

### App name

Darkest Fear and Totomi

### App version

1.0

### touchHLE version

v0.2.2-1009-g069621db

### Operating system

Android 13

### GPU

Mali-G72

### What is the problem with the app?

I tried running Darkest Fear and Totomi in the latest preview build, but they both crash with the same error: "Call to unimplemented function ___assert_rtn", though they both worked very well in previous versions. Please look into the issue and take your time.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/98f48e9d-fc20-4429-94cb-8e9d005be7c2)

comments.author: ciciplusplus
comments.body:
I cannot reproduce on my side on macOS, DarkestFear 1.0 is still working as expected.

Could you try to run the game with `--ignore-gl-errors` option enabled?

comments.author: DaCringeyBaka
comments.body: The option worked with both games, thanks for the tip!
